preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices u_i and v_i in the edges must be valid vertex numbers within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of vertices that can be saved from infection.
